items.text: The remote control should be user-friendly and accessible to all age groups, including older adults who may struggle with complex interfaces or programming.
The remote control design should incorporate a simple LCD display with intuitive menus, similar to mobile phones, to improve navigation and reduce the number of physical buttons.
The remote control should include a feature for large print or enhanced readability, especially for older users, to ensure accessibility.
The remote control design does not need to be fashion-forward or styled like a mobile phone; it can remain lightweight and made from plastic for cost and practicality.
Sarah will document and share meeting notes in a shared folder for future reference.
Team members are to go off and work individually on their design concepts for the remote control.
Team members are to return to the meeting for a follow-up discussion after their individual work.
The team will revisit the design concepts in the next meeting to evaluate and refine ideas.
The remote control should be designed to integrate multiple functions into one device, eliminating the need for multiple remotes.
The remote control should avoid complex button layouts with small, unclear labels or symbols that are difficult to interpret.
The remote control should have a flip-top design to provide a larger screen when flipped open, potentially improving usability.
The product should be priced at 25 euros, with a production cost of 12.50 euros, resulting in a significant profit margin.
